mentions.name: localsetup
mentions.description: A hobby Rust CLI tool that automates setting up a new machine for a user account: installing packages, setting up an SSH key, cloning git repositories, configuring dotfiles, and installing rustup/Rust. Distributed as a single dependency-free binary pulled from CI, replacing the author's previous messy collection of bash setup scripts.
mentions.problem: Setting up each new machine means repeating the same manual steps (packages, SSH key, repo clones, dotfiles, Rust), and managing this with bash scripts proved messy and hard to maintain.

Hobby. Very rudimentary, not everything working yet.
